prompt.text: It is their last day. The screen is a file share they do not work in. A copy is running to a small drive, and they close the laptop when you walk up.

choices.label: Let it go. It is their last day.
choices.debrief: Last day is the reason to look, not the reason to look away.
choices.report: A copy off a share they do not work in was ignored.
choices.voice_line: You saw a copy running and let it finish.

fallout.text: The drive leaves with them. The share shows the copy completed after you walked past.

choices.label: Tell security what you saw, including the closed laptop
choices.debrief: You do not have to accuse them. You do have to say what the screen was doing.
choices.report: Security was told about the copy and the closed laptop.
choices.voice_line: You told security what you saw. You did not have to decide why.

choices.label: Ask them to stop, and leave it there
choices.debrief: Asking ends the moment you saw. It does not end the copy.
choices.report: You asked them to stop and did not report it.
choices.voice_line: You asked them to stop, and no one else was told.

fallout.text: The copy finishes after you leave the aisle.

draft_note: Pairs with the insider-risk module. Reporting is the right end, not a confrontation.
